title: Finally! StowStow Demo is Live
author: PeakyBull
selftext:
Wishing everyone a **good day**! I had explained where and how I use AI in my previous posts, and I received great feedback from you all. Thank you for the great interest you have shown in my posts here.

Now, I am proud to announce that I have released the StowStow Demo on Steam. I would also like to specially thank everyone who has played and provided feedback so far.

You can access the StowStow Demo page [here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4975580/StowStow_Demo/). **Thanks to everyone in advance!**

Your feedback is always very important to me, it helps a lot in improving the game and fixing bugs.
